mission_priority: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery; Barrot V3 is execution and verification foundation

sources.observation: Hourly Gumroad API read; selected sales emails were normalized and SHA-256 hashed; hashes and count were committed to public web/subscribers.json.
JSON parsed successfully; emails array length 0 and count 0 at capture. No subscriber hashes were exposed in this audit output.
15-minute scheduled executor had contents:write and actions:write, invoked scripts/scheduler.py with GITHUB_TOKEN, and pushed queue updates to main.
Scheduled issue creation with issues:write; public digest may propagate the legacy unvalidated signal-accuracy claim.
Scheduled batch issue resolver had issues:write and could close matching issues.
Hourly autonomous issue/PR resolver could create issues and assign unassigned items.
Scheduled gap detector could create and label GitHub issues.
Existing CI-included test module; two new workflow-containment regression tests are appended in this proposal.

findings.summary: Unrestricted scheduler can dispatch arbitrary workflow files every 15 minutes and persist queue state directly to main.
Subscriber sync publishes unsalted SHA-256 email hashes. Such hashes are pseudonymous and dictionary-matchable, not anonymization.
Scheduled digest and autonomous issue workflows perform public issue/PR mutations without per-item user authorization.
web/subscribers.json currently contains zero hashes; no subscriber identifiers were exposed by this audit.

proposed_controls: Disable the 15-minute scheduler workflow until a reviewed workflow allowlist and durable non-main queue store exist.
Disable the hourly subscriber export pending privacy review and a non-public, access-controlled subscriber store.
Disable scheduled digest and autonomous issue/PR mutation pending explicit authorization, deduplication and bounded scopes.
Use permissions: {}, workflow_dispatch-only and a job-level false guard; remove credential references and mutation commands.
Add regression tests to tests/test_v3_scripts.py, which is explicitly enumerated in core CI.
limitations: This PR does not erase prior Git objects, forks, caches or external copies.
The current subscriber JSON is empty; prior versions/history were not audited for previously published hashes.
No Gumroad API call, secret access, workflow dispatch, issue mutation, deployment, merge, paper trade or real-money action was performed.
Manual workflow dispatch remains visible but the job is disabled; administrative branch protection is not changed.
Merge Queue, Dump Brain Corpus, Cross Analysis and legacy signal-accuracy workflows remain separate unresolved main-branch risks.
next_actions: Run exact-head core CI and confirm both new test names are collected.
Run the fail-closed gate and verify automatic merge remains disabled.
Audit Git history for prior subscriber hashes through authorized public repository history; do not rewrite history without explicit approval.
Prepare separate fresh-main containment for Merge Queue and Dump Brain Corpus.
Continue the point-in-time XRP feature store and fixed-horizon evaluation work.
